title: International Business follow-up asks a new topic
subject: Application for International Business Master

turns.email_text:
Dear Admissions Team,

My name is Ananya and I am completing my Bachelor's degree in Business Administration in India. I would like to apply for the Master's in International Business for the winter semester. Since I will receive my final transcript only in July, can I still apply before graduation? Do I need English language proof and are there application fees?

Kind regards,
Ananya
Thank you for your reply. Is a motivation letter also required?

subject: Cybersecurity and Business Bachelor application
